method: Performed a W6 whole-lesson review of parallel tool execution semantics, tool-result/error mapping, stop states, retry/idempotency boundaries, SQLite side effects, examples, metadata and evidence scope. Ran the prior issue verifier, a new offline full-lesson verifier, the complete two Python fences, and SQLite identity/amount/rollback fixtures. Reviewed Anthropic parallel-tool, tool-call, stop-reason, extended-thinking and API-error documentation, Stripe idempotency behavior, and OWASP authorization guidance. No provider or external effect was invoked. Rendered the complete lesson in light and dark themes at a 1300px viewport; article width was 792px, document scroll width was 1300px and the Mermaid diagram rendered in both. The only console error was the existing missing favicon 404.
limitations: The 2026-10-08 DeepSeek stdout summaries lack raw requests, responses, sample mapping and scorer, so historical model behavior remains unreproduced.
SQLite fixtures establish only local transaction behavior; no production database, identity provider, authorization service, distributed idempotency store or cross-system side effect was tested.
Provider protocol claims are scoped to the cited Anthropic Messages API; Stripe documents its own API-specific idempotency behavior.
OWASP guidance supports request/object authorization checks; the verifier does not implement or validate a production authorization policy.
The lesson remains in-review for missing historical provider artifacts and untested production behavior.
